about.intro: VocazAI was born in Casablanca in 2025. We believe SMBs that power Morocco and Africa deserve the same tools as the big groups — without the complexity or the CIO budget.

mission.title: A receptionist for everyone.
mission.p1: Too many small businesses still lose 40% of their inbound calls. Overflowing clinics, restaurants in rush, real estate agents on viewings — humans can't be everywhere.
mission.p2: We build AI voice agents that sound like your best receptionist. They pick up in under a second, understand darija, French and English, and know when to hand off to a human.
mission.p3: Goal: no SMB ever loses a customer to a missed call again.

v1.title: Local first
v1.body: We speak darija, we know how appointment booking works in the region, we configure from Casablanca. Not a US Vapi clone.

v2.title: Radical transparency
v2.body: Prices displayed. No opaque contracts. Your data is yours, exportable or deletable in one click.

v3.title: Tech without hype
v3.body: We use what works — GPT-4o, ElevenLabs, Deepgram. No vague AI promises, just calls that get answered.

story.title: Born from a missed call.
story.p1: One evening in 2024, the founder of VocazAI tried to call a clinic for a loved one. Eight rings. Nobody. A second clinic. Same. A third. Finally someone — but the appointment was three weeks out.
story.p2: At the same time, OpenAI released GPT-4o with voice mode. ElevenLabs published a North African French voice that sounded almost human. Deepgram hit 200ms French speech-to-text. All the bricks were there.
story.p3: Six months later, VocazAI launched its MVP with three pilot medical practices in Casablanca. None of them miss a call anymore.

useCases.intro: Every sector has its scenarios, vocabulary, priorities. We configure your agent so it sounds native to your business.

clinic.title: Clinics & medical practices
clinic.lede: Never again a patient on voicemail.
clinic.body: Your agent picks up in under a second, triages urgency (red/yellow/green), proposes a slot in your calendar and sends an SMS confirmation. For urgent cases, it transfers immediately to the on-call line.
clinic.b1: Doctolib / Google Calendar / custom calendar integration

realty.title: Real estate agencies
realty.body: Your agent takes every inbound call, qualifies the buyer or renter profile (budget, area, surface, urgency), books a viewing and syncs with your CRM. Your salespeople only call hot leads.

ecom.title: E-commerce & delivery
ecom.body: In Morocco, 70% of e-commerce is paid cash-on-delivery. Your agent calls back every customer within 5 minutes of order, confirms address and availability, and drastically cuts return rates.
ecom.b2: Webhook to your back-office (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom)

restau.title: Restaurants & hospitality
restau.body: Your agent takes reservations 24/7, in 3 languages. It knows your menu, handles special requests (allergies, birthdays), proposes available slots and adds the booking to your floor management software.

cta.title: Your industry not in the list?
cta.body: We configure custom agents for pretty much anything that involves a phone. Let's talk.
